summary: All 87 manifest entries matched their recorded SHA-256 hashes and sizes, and all eight original computations reproduced. The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. The reviewed author results provide no gene-level male-versus-female estimate across all six sequencing pools. The corrected proposal records the donor-age discrepancy and the 929 cells included in the registered analysis that the authors excluded from later cluster analyses. It passed the ledger checker.
openIssues: The number and ages of mice contributing to each pool remain unresolved. GEO reports three mice per pool aged 60–70 days. The sequencing methods report four to five mice per sex per replicate at approximately seven to eight weeks.
